skills.name: invideo
skills.description: Read first for any video with invideo, a professional AI-native video editor: how to connect, the work loop, cost, and every job type: launches, ads, commercials, product and personal videos, invitations, intros, type, explainers, films, shorts, captions.

skills.name: invideo-media
skills.description: Get and check media for an invideo video: the person's uploads, stock video, images and music, rights, and the craft of voice-over, music, sound effects, cleanup and dubbing.

skills.name: invideo-generate
skills.description: Generate images, video, voice-over, music, sound effects and 3D for an invideo video: picking and prompting a model, pricing, narration first, retries.

skills.name: invideo-timeline
skills.description: Use for operations depth on an invideo timeline: frame math, tracks and layering, keyframes and motion, speed ramps, grades, LUTs, effects and custom shaders, audio buses, ducking and loudness.

skills.name: invideo-pipeline
skills.description: Use for scale and automation: a CSV to many videos, `--json`, idempotency keys, CI with device sign-in, outreach at scale, course batches, bulk orders, and several agents sharing one project.
